service.description: Update the address on Aadhaar online (myAadhaar) with a proof of address. The updated Aadhaar can be downloaded once the request is approved.
service.depending: Aadhaar number, mobile number linked with Aadhaar (for OTP), proof of address in the holder's name (e.g. electricity bill, bank passbook, ration card, rent agreement)
service.rules: Online update needs the mobile number linked with Aadhaar. The name on the address proof must match Aadhaar. Give the URN (update request number) slip to the customer.
